$Comment: An example generated dungeon: every party that enters gets a fresh layout of Stone kit rooms from the plan Zc_Example_Stone, written into the world around them as they walk, and clears it by holding out for five minutes.

It ships switched off, so no server lists it unasked. To try it, write { "Zc_Example_Stone": { "Enabled": true } } in the server's mods/ziggfreedcommon/dungeons.json and restart; nothing in the world leads here, so an admin goes in with /zigdungeon enter Zc_Example_Stone. /zigdungeon layout Zc_Example_Stone <seed> lists the rooms a seed lays out either way. A pack makes its own by naming its own plan in Area.Layout.
